title: The obligatory cell and its declaration
statement: An obligatory cell is read over a supplied lattice, epoch and dependency world. Required and signed bounds, live attributed claims and rest remain distinct parts of one object. A declaration is a demand/limit projection; it is not a replacement cell.
boundary: No new Cell, authority evaluator or fixed set of application regions. A witnessed local widening never travels. Cell state counts named origins, not authenticated or independent causes.

paper.scope: Consume the cited theorem under its stated valuation class; finite API vectors check implementation correspondence, not a new proof of the cited theorem.
